subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS SecretRef activation land while a missing active TTS credential can still abort Gateway startup, or wait for the optional-TTS degradation policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: This PR correctly expands which credentials become active, but that expansion also exposes existing configurations to the shared fail-closed startup contract; code review cannot choose the intended release ordering or operator impact.

options.title: Sequence after degradation policy
options.body: Fix and prove this PR, then land it after the optional missing-TTS-key behavior is resolved so activation does not unexpectedly take down the Gateway.

options.title: Accept fail-closed activation
options.body: Land after the collector and proof blockers are fixed, explicitly accepting that missing persona TTS credentials can block Gateway startup.

options.title: Pause both changes
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose a broader TTS credential activation and degradation contract.

recommendation.title: Sequence after degradation policy
recommendation.body: Fix and prove this PR, then land it after the optional missing-TTS-key behavior is resolved so activation does not unexpectedly take down the Gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged SecretRef expansion established the runtime activation contract and affected ownership boundary.
